findings.claim: Zero-length gate recvmsg and 200ms start_ack send timeout reproduced when a second process retains the shared gate endpoint during the worker ready/ack exchange (probe D2); not reproduced when the supervisor closes its copy first (D1).
Empty datagram is not peer close: peer close gives one ECONNRESET then timeouts (prior probe).
Monitor runs pump first inside one broad try; persistent pump errors skip cancel/cutoff/TERM/KILL/absence/cleanup_complete/deadline duties.
Fixture guard only checks that an injection event exists; r9 injection fired in latch_phase FAILURE after unrelated failure and was accepted as injection_reached.

monitor: order duties safety/cleanup first, pump last
separate try per duty, retain earliest failure, bounded dedup cleanup_errors
mark channel lost on first ECONNRESET/EDESTADDRREQ
start_ack sent at most once; gate_acked failed on exception
no added allowance or ACK retry
proposal.transport_candidate: supervisor closes gate copy immediately after Popen returns; adopt only if discriminator D1-delayed-ack reproduces and D3 does not
proposal.fixture_guard: injection must occur in expected latch phase, with named pre-injection milestones and no earlier first_global_failure; else fixture_precondition_failed

next_discriminator.description: one preregistered probe: D1 with executor registered-ack delayed 400ms past worker_ready; D3 gate closed right after Popen

regression_gates: monitor with forever-raising pump still performs TERM/KILL/absence/deadline exit within pool.until
start_ack send exception yields exactly one attempt, no resend
OS fixture with late registered ack classified deterministically
